english.title: Cause / permit fail to retain record of conventionally reared meat chickens in each house - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, caused or permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to be responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), when a record required to be maintained under paragraph 13(1) of Schedule 5A to the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Wales) Regulations 2007 was not retained for at least 3 years
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1)(ba), 7(1)(c) and 9 of, and paragraph 13(2) of Schedule 5A to, the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Wales) Regulations 2007.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant, without lawful authority or excuse, caused or permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to be responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), when a record required to be maintained under paragraph 13(1) of Schedule 5A to the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Wales) Regulations 2007 was not retained for at least 3 years.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
